children: EGAIN Corp reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $91.14M, up from $88.43M a year earlier, while net income fell to $8.88M and diluted EPS declined to $0.32— according to the company's 10-K filing for the year.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by higher demand in core product lines and price realization.
The company noted a shift toward direct-to-consumer and e-commerce channels, reducing reliance on wholesale partners.
Brand awareness was strengthened through expanded marketing, new product launches and improved customer retention.
Operationally, EGAIN completed capacity expansion and automation upgrades to improve throughput and reduce lead times.
Management projects continued top-line growth and margin improvement supported by channel mix and operational efficiencies.
